label: s1_side02_0010_camera_01
text: Oh! Hey, kiddo! Wait, don’t tell me—[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0010_camera_02
text: You actually caught over 150 Pokémon from the\nKitakami Pokédex?!\c\nNow I KNOW you’re the real deal![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0010_select_01
text: That’s right!

label: s1_side02_0010_select_02
text: It’s not that much...

label: s1_side02_0010_camera_03
text: Pretty impressive! You must really be something\nspecial, kiddo![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0010_camera_04
text: Hahaha! No need to act modest, kiddo! You\nshould be proud![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0010_camera_05
text: You probably know more about the Pokémon\nhere in Kitakami than I do—and I got here first![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0010_camera_06
text: Which reminds me![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0010_camera_07
text: I’ve got a favor to ask you, see. A real Pokémon-\ncatching pro like you is just what I need.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0010_select_03
text: What kind of favor?

label: s1_side02_0010_select_04
text: Not interested...

label: s1_side02_0010_camera_08
text: Ooh, did I tickle your curiosity? Glad you don’t\nseem afraid to poke your head into new things!\r\nIn that case, let me tell you what I’m all about.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0010_camera_09
text: Kiddo! Come ON! It’s important to take detours\nin life sometimes, don’t you know that?\c\nSo yeah, I’m just gonna tell you anyway.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0010_camera_10
text: The reason I came here to Kitakami was actually\nto find a certain Pokémon...and photograph it.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0010_camera_11
text: I’ve been searching on my own for ages, but I\nstill haven’t found it![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0010_camera_12
text: So, kiddo...how about doing me a solid by\nhelping me with my search? I’d owe you forever![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0010_camera_13
text: Rumor has it that the Pokémon I’m looking for\nis pretty ferociously strong.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0010_camera_14
text: Just think! You could catch it and bring it along\non your adventures! Wouldn’t that be helpful?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0010_camera_15
text: That enough to pique your interest? If so, I’ll\nneed you to prove you’re strong enough to help.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0010_camera_16
text:
If we’re really gonna partner up on this thing,
then I want to know you’re cut out for it.\c
That, and I want to get a good shot of you
looking all heroic and everything.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
